draft.quote: Three workers were injured when drones struck the Ust-Luga port zone in Russia's Leningrad region overnight on November 10–11.
draft.summary: Drones struck the Ust-Luga port zone overnight, starting a fire and shutting down a transformer substation, Baird Maritime reports. Ukraine's Security Service said the attack damaged storage tanks, pumping stations, pipelines and oil transshipment infrastructure, and Ukraine's General Staff said five petroleum-product tanks and a tanker-loading berth were hit. Russian authorities have not said whether cargo handling or vessel movements were disrupted.
